### Root Cause

When nested blueprints are registered on an application (`src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py:302-304`, `376-377`), each blueprint is registered in `app.blueprints` and its callbacks (`before_request_funcs`, `error_handler_spec`, `template_context_processors`, `after_request_funcs`, `teardown_request_funcs`, `url_default_functions`, `url_value_preprocessors`) are stored in the `app` dictionaries under its full dotted registration name from root to leaf (e.g. `"parent"`, `"parent.child"`, `"parent.child.grandchild"` in `src/flask/sansio/blueprints.py:379-410`).

During request handling, Flask resolves the active blueprint hierarchy via `Request.blueprints` (`src/flask/wrappers.py:181-195`), which calls `_split_blueprint_path(self.blueprint)` (`src/flask/helpers.py:645-651`). `Flask.preprocess_request` (`src/flask/app.py:1377`), `Flask._find_error_handler` (`src/flask/sansio/app.py:874`), `Flask.update_template_context` (`src/flask/app.py:607`), `Flask.process_response` (`src/flask/app.py:1410`), `Flask.do_teardown_request` (`src/flask/app.py:1442`), and `App.inject_url_defaults` (`src/flask/sansio/app.py:970`) all rely on `_split_blueprint_path` returning the registered names from the current blueprint upwards through its parent blueprints (e.g. `["parent.child", "parent"]`).

In `src/flask/helpers.py:649`, `_split_blueprint_path` used `name.partition(".")[2]` instead of `name.rpartition(".")[0]`:
- With `name.partition(".")[2]`, `_split_blueprint_path("parent.child")` stripped the leftmost prefix and recursed on `"child"`, returning `["parent.child", "child"]`. Because the parent blueprint's callbacks are registered under `"parent"` (and the child's under `"parent.child"`), `"parent"` was never included in `request.blueprints`, so parent-level handlers were never looked up.
- With `name.rpartition(".")[0]`, `_split_blueprint_path("parent.child.grandchild")` strips the rightmost segment at each step and returns `["parent.child.grandchild", "parent.child", "parent"]`.

### Fix

* `src/flask/helpers.py:649`: Changed `name.partition(".")[2]` to `name.rpartition(".")[0]` in `_split_blueprint_path`.
* `tests/test_blueprints.py:994-1052`: Added regression test `test_nested_blueprint_parent_callbacks` verifying `request.blueprints`, parent/app/child `before_request` ordering, parent/app `context_processor` inheritance, and `@parent.errorhandler(418)` handling `abort(418)` from child and grandchild routes.

// source/core/Ky.ts:340-346
static #normalizeSearchParams(searchParams: SearchParamsOption): SearchParamsOption {
	// Filter out undefined values from plain objects
	if (searchParams && typeof searchParams === 'object' && !Array.isArray(searchParams) && !(searchParams instanceof URLSearchParams)) {
		return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(searchParams).filter(([, value]) => Boolean(value)));
